This business used to belong to a good friend of mine and I’ve used for many years, always feeling very well supported and offering excellent service. Now it has a new ownership under Sandro and Fabiana and I want to say, after taking my frenchie there for over 5 months, I am extremely happy with not only the detailed service and grooming they provide, but the kindness and warmth with which they both greet us every time we go for grooming. Even when it’s hard to find a parking spot Sandro always comes and picks Ribs up so I can be more relaxed. Thank you guys for being so special and thank you for taking such good care of my Ribs every time I go there. Next time dental cleaning !!! 🙏🏼

Dana, my 3-pound Yorkie, has been going to Fabiana for the past 7 years, and I truly wouldn’t trust anyone else with her.

I’ve had several groomers over the years, but no one compares to Faby. She is incredibly detail-oriented, always punctual, responsible, and consistently greets everyone with a warm smile. Most importantly, she treats every pet with genuine love and care, which gives me complete peace of mind.

I’m so happy to see her thriving with her new business, Kenny & Dolly Pet Grooming. It’s actually funny to scroll through Instagram and realize how many friends and clients I know also bring their pets to Faby—we all have her in common for a reason!

If you’re looking for a groomer who is talented, trustworthy, and truly passionate about what she does, I wholeheartedly recommend Kenny & Dolly Pet Grooming. They have earned all five stars from me, and I look forward to many more years of bringing Dana to Faby.
